summary: Applied Owner amendment A0003 at the SPEC layer to exactly the eight PLANNED contracts T049, T050, T052, T053, T063, T064, T084 and T085, plus docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md and spec_revision; no other file changed. (1) docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md: added WEB-PAGE-008 data coverage and downloads, WEB-PAGE-009 replay and position inspector, WEB-PAGE-010 dataset builder and WEB-PAGE-011 model laboratory, each stating what it shows and each stating explicitly that it is owned by T103 and lies outside T084's acceptance; extended WEB-PAGE-004 so performance is broken down by market regime and time slice, each slice reporting the number of independent episodes behind it and an uncertainty interval (UNCERTAIN when the sample does not support one) instead of a bare point estimate; extended WEB-GLOBAL-001 so every page shows the active dataset version and the reporting numeraire and so a RELATIVE_ONLY dataset is visibly distinguishable from a USD-denominated one; added four visualisation-minimum bullets covering coverage maps, replay timelines, dataset and label provenance, and model diagnostics; section 5 is unchanged and every pre-existing page and clause is retained verbatim apart from the header date. (2) T053: the USDG-only framing is generalised to the ADR-014 reporting-numeraire hierarchy (USDG first, then a qualified USD stablecoin, ETH display-only), a RELATIVE_ONLY dataset is added that carries no USD-denominated field anywhere, USDG stays mandatory for the active execution pool and for both 5-minute extreme-move rules, and the observed-at/available-at, provenance and staleness semantics are kept and required per numeraire. (3) T052: every rebalancing-loss figure is labelled a proxy with its declared reference basis (LP_METRICS M-LVR-001, reference M-BM-002) and never as a measured LVR; breakeven volatility (M-BE-001) is solved from the replay's own fee series and rebalancing-cost series and reported with its window and annualisation; RELATIVE_ONLY attribution stays relative with no USD-denominated field. (4) T049: an added Numeraire boundary section states the sizing mathematics is numeraire-independent, the integer and liquidityDelta discipline is unchanged, and the reporting numeraire applies only to the capital envelope and its reporting. (5) T050: an added Ownership boundary section assigns time/block bars and market features to T050 and the research panel labels to T101, and every bar now carries its unit, window, data time and availability time. (6) T063: the manifest additionally records the dataset version the run consumes and the reporting numeraire with its valuation qualification, and a manifest missing either, or disagreeing with the dataset's qualification record, fails validation. (7) T064: pool holdout is the primary generalisation test with time holdout and walk-forward retained beside it, and the purge and embargo length is derived from the declared label horizon and recorded with each split. (8) T084: acceptance is narrowed to the WEB-GLOBAL-*, read-only WEB-PAGE-* and visualisation requirements owned by the P08 web-console tasks T083–T086, and the four T103-owned pages are stated to lie outside its acceptance and to be neither required nor blocked by it. (9) T085: research dataset and model definitions are versioned through the same draft → impact preview → reauthentication → confirmation write path yet can never become an execution approval, appear as one, or be reachable from an execution-shaped control. spec_revision raised from v1-2026-09-19-research-universe to v1-2026-09-19-numeraire-web-console. Every added quantity states its unit and availability time, and no existing acceptance clause was weakened or removed; no task status, attempt, evidence pointer, commit SHA, review record, approval datum, dependency field or agent-runtime setting changed, and the eight target tasks remain PLANNED at attempt 0.
rationale: Owner direction mapping, item by item. Item 1(a): the four new pages are added at the end of section 3, each with a statement of what it shows (coverage calendar over the measured per-pool datasets with missing ranges shown as missing; reconstructed pool state, tick liquidity, the swaps that moved it and a hypothetical position's range, inventory, fees and PnL; dataset building with segment roles, explicit pool and time holdout, qualification summary and a saved versioned definition; training and evaluation runs, calibration, quantile coverage, baseline comparison and rejection records) and each closing with an explicit sentence that T103 owns it and that it lies outside T084's acceptance, so the requirement text and T103's existing contract agree. Item 1(b): the results-view requirement extended is WEB-PAGE-004 (strategy research and backtest), which is where sample-out performance and comparison are specified; the episode count and the uncertainty interval, and the UNCERTAIN fallback, are made display requirements so a page can satisfy them by rendering what a report contains and showing the absence explicitly instead of fabricating a point estimate. Item 1(c): WEB-GLOBAL-001 gains the active dataset version and the reporting numeraire (USDG, qualified USD stablecoin, or ETH labelled as volatile display) for every page, makes RELATIVE_ONLY textually and visually distinguishable, forbids a dollar sign or any USD-denominated field on RELATIVE_ONLY results, and points at WEB-GLOBAL-002 for the expandable provenance. Item 1(d): four bullets were added to section 4 rather than rewriting existing ones, so the pre-existing time-series, price, PnL, position and comparison clauses are untouched. Item 1(e): section 5 is byte-identical and no existing page or clause was removed or weakened (verified by diff: every changed line in the eight contracts and the spec appends to the pre-existing sentence or adds a new labelled section). Item 2: the eight contracts keep their identity, status, attempt and dependency fields; only body text changed, and each edit adds a clearly labelled section or extends Deliverables/Acceptance/Must not additively. T053 generalises the quote source to the ADR-014 hierarchy — USDG when present with a qualified valuation, otherwise a qualified USD stablecoin that passed the same qualification, ETH reserved for display — adds the RELATIVE_ONLY dataset with no USD-denominated field anywhere, keeps the execution path unchanged (active-pool valuation, exposure, risk budget and both 5-minute rules still require a qualified point-in-time USDG conversion, and USDG remains mandatory), and states that availability-time, provenance and staleness semantics must hold per selected numeraire rather than only for USDG. T052 labels every rebalancing-loss figure a proxy with its declared reference (LP_METRICS M-LVR-001, reference M-BM-002), requires breakeven volatility (M-BE-001) solved from the replay's own fee and rebalancing series with window and annualisation, and keeps RELATIVE_ONLY attribution relative. T049 states the sizing mathematics is numeraire-independent, the canonical-integer and liquidityDelta discipline is unchanged (one liquidity scale, no one-sided trimming, no Range change), and the numeraire applies only to the capital envelope and its reporting. T063 records the dataset version and reporting numeraire in the manifest in addition to everything it recorded before and makes their absence a validation failure. T064 adds pool holdout as the primary generalisation test with purge and embargo derived from the declared label horizon, alongside the retained walk-forward, holdout and parameter-surface requirements. T084 narrows acceptance to the WEB-GLOBAL-*, read-only WEB-PAGE-* and visualisation requirements owned by the P08 web-console tasks T083–T086 (the phrase is transcribed from the recorded direction; the visualisation requirements of section 4 are the same set T084 already owned) and states that the four T103-owned pages lie outside its acceptance, which is what makes the task passable once those pages exist in the specification. T085 puts research dataset and model definitions through the task's versioned write path while forbidding them from becoming, appearing as, or being reachable from an execution approval or an execution-shaped control. Every added quantity carries a unit and an availability time, and no ADR is reopened: ADR-014 and ADR-015 are cited, never rewritten, and docs/intent/ was not touched. Item 3: spec_revision was raised to a new, distinct value. Item 4: the constraints hold — changed paths are exactly docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md, the eight named task files and todo/config.yaml (spec_revision only, verified by diff: every task record's status, attempt, base/candidate/approved commit, latest_review and depends_on is byte-identical); docs/intent/ and every non-target contract are untouched; T022, T023 and T038 are cited nowhere; and the added text contains no URL, API key, authorization header, address or environment value. Verification performed (investigation only, not acceptance evidence): python -m tools.workflow validate returns OK, tests/test_workflow_contracts.py and tests/test_no_signing_paths.py pass, git diff --check reports no whitespace errors, and the changed path set was confirmed against the SPEC-layer allowance that finish-amendment enforces. The FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778 markers and all other contract identity text were deliberately left in place because the direction requires identity fields to be kept and the toolchain does not require a marker change.
unresolved_questions: docs/implement/TRACEABILITY.md is now stale and disagrees with the console specification in two ways: its `G-UI-01` row still says 七页 Web 控制台 (seven pages) while the specification now defines eleven, and its specification-to-task row maps `WEB-GLOBAL-*`/`WEB-PAGE-*` to T084–T086 while the four new pages are owned by T103. The file's own update rule requires syncing `WEB-*` changes, but the recorded direction limits this amendment to docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md, the eight contracts and spec_revision, and TRACEABILITY.md is neither a target contract nor an allowed path in any layer of this amendment; the index needs a separate Owner-authorised amendment to be brought into line.

T084's acceptance now requires the results view to show the market-regime and time-slice breakdown with the independent-episode count and an uncertainty interval behind each slice, but T084's dependency set (T025, T063, T072, T080) contains no dependency on T064, which is where regime segmentation and episode-level uncertainty are produced. The recorded direction forbids changing dependency fields, so the contract is written as a display requirement that a page satisfies by rendering what the report contains and marking absence as UNCERTAIN; if the Owner wants the segmentation source as a direct dependency edge for T084, that requires a separate CONTRACT-layer amendment.

Section 4 of docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md retains its pre-existing bullet requiring the position chart to show the USDG equivalent, while the numeraire hierarchy now permits a research dataset whose reporting numeraire is a non-USDG qualified stablecoin or is RELATIVE_ONLY (where no USD-denominated field may appear at all). The global rule extended in WEB-GLOBAL-001 governs which numeraire a page shows, and this amendment deliberately did not edit that pre-existing bullet; if the Owner wants the chart bullet itself to name the dataset's reporting numeraire and to forbid a USD equivalent on a RELATIVE_ONLY dataset, that is a further specification edit rather than something this direction authorised.
